name: Haus Erbhof
beschreibung: The Gasthof Haus Erbhof is situated in a quiet location in Tirol, nestled in the surrounding mountain landscape. The rooms are traditionally furnished and offer comfort with regional materials. In the in-house restaurant, Tiroler Spezialitäten from the region are served. Nearby, hiking trails are accessible in summer and ski areas in winter. The special atmosphere of the house is shaped by its family-run management.
